name: M15 directional close-streak continuation and exhaustion screening batch

source_references.citation: Perry J. Kaufman, Trading Systems and Methods; frozen legacy backlog cites an unspecified edition at page 1010 for a four-down-close rule
source_references.supports: Wiley verifies current bibliographic metadata only. The legacy book-derived rule is longer-horizon context, not direct cost-aware M15 FX evidence, and motivates only a symmetric falsification territory.

research.evidence_summary: No inspected source establishes a net M15 FX streak edge. A frozen legacy four-down-close idea and exhaustion setup motivate a symmetric continuation-versus-reversal test, but the local rule is original, speculative, and low-prior.

feasibility.rationale: Only supported M1 OHLC, causal M15 state, signal-close fills, ATR stops and same-day exits are required; isolated batch execution and result transport still need V2 confirmation.

market.session: Weekday signals from completed M15 bars ending 09:00 through 12:45 Europe/London; every exit due no later than 15:00

data.frequency: Interval-start M1 OHLC aggregated into Europe/London wall-clock M15 intervals
data.minimum_history: Fixed V2 development data only, with 98 valid observed completed M15 closes through signal bar t; elapsed market gaps do not reset prior ATR state, but every bar t-N through t must be physically adjacent at 15-minute spacing
preprocessing: Treat M1 timestamp ts as [ts,ts+1 minute); a London M15 bar ending 09:00 contains [08:45,09:00)

Require exactly 15 consecutive unique valid M1 candles per M15 bar; valid OHLC is finite and positive with high>=max(open,close), low<=min(open,close), and high>=low; a duplicate is invalid before aggregation

Compute TR=max(high-low,abs(high-previous_observed_close),abs(low-previous_observed_close)), including elapsed daily/weekend gaps; seed Wilder ATR(96) from the arithmetic mean of the first 96 valid observed TRs, recur ATR_i=(95*ATR_{i-1}+TR_i)/96, and freeze through t-1
Use IANA Europe/London rules and canonical UTC storage
dependencies: V2 resolved signal-time spread, commission and slippage
limitations: A close streak may be random serial clustering rather than persistent order flow
The source context is book-derived, asymmetric and longer-horizon
Six correlated symbols and 72 correlated cells are not independent trials
No development result authorizes final-holdout access

hypothesis.behavior: After N consecutive same-direction M15 close changes with sufficient net displacement, the next short horizon may continue because of persistent flow or reverse because of short-term exhaustion.
hypothesis.mechanism: Continuation may reflect gradual order execution; reversal may reflect crowded short-horizon pressure and liquidity replenishment after a one-sided path.
works_when: The path is physically contiguous and its net displacement is material relative to prior ATR
One response sign persists across exact neighboring streak lengths, thresholds and exits
fails_when: Streak frequency matches random sign clustering
The response occurs before signal-close entry
falsifiable_predictions: A response-mode center and at least two exact one-axis neighbors have positive net R
The cluster is positive in both UTC-midpoint development halves and at least three symbols
The cluster survives doubled costs and removal of the center's five best London dates

definitions.name: atr96_prior
definitions.formula: Wilder ATR(96) over valid observed M15 true ranges through t-1, using previous observed close across elapsed gaps
definitions.timing: Frozen before signal bar t; require finite and positive

definitions.name: streak_direction
definitions.formula: +1 when close_{i}>close_{i-1} for every i=t-N+1...t; -1 when close_{i}<close_{i-1} for every such i; otherwise no signal
definitions.timing: Uses N completed close changes across physically adjacent bars t-N...t; equality breaks the streak

definitions.name: net_displacement_ratio
definitions.timing: Computed at completed signal-bar close using the frozen prior ATR

definitions.name: trade_side
definitions.formula: streak_direction for CONTINUATION and -streak_direction for EXHAUSTION

entries.long_condition: eligible completed M15 t AND net_displacement_ratio>=displacement_atr_min AND ((streak_direction=+1 AND response_mode=CONTINUATION) OR (streak_direction=-1 AND response_mode=EXHAUSTION)) AND no open position for this symbol and cell
entries.short_condition: eligible completed M15 t AND net_displacement_ratio>=displacement_atr_min AND ((streak_direction=-1 AND response_mode=CONTINUATION) OR (streak_direction=+1 AND response_mode=EXHAUSTION)) AND no open position for this symbol and cell
entries.signal_time: Close of a London-aligned M15 interval ending 09:00 through 12:45 on a weekday when signal time plus holding_minutes is no later than 15:00
entries.execution_details: entry_price is the chart/bid close of M1 [signal_time-1 minute,signal_time), also completed M15 close_t. Stop distance uses that chart price; V2 applies resolved or fixed-fallback spread, commission and slippage. The entry candle cannot trigger the new stop; management begins with the next M1.
entries.order_type: Market order at supported signal-close execution
restrictions: One open position per symbol per cell
No pyramiding or reset from overlapping streaks
Every bar t-N through t must be physically adjacent
A zero close change breaks both streak directions

exits.stop_loss: Long bid-chart stop = signal_close_bid-stop_atr_multiplier*atr96_prior; short bid-chart stop = signal_close_bid+stop_atr_multiplier*atr96_prior. Long triggers on bid, short on executable ask; adverse gap fills at V2's worse executable open with all costs.
exits.time_exit: Exit at the M1 close ending exactly signal_time plus holding_minutes; any invalid M1 in (entry_time,due_exit_time] fails the affected cell before exit; a valid due bar touching the stop resolves STOP_LOSS first
exits.maximum_holding: At most 120 minutes and never after 15:00 Europe/London
exits.end_of_session: No eligible entry may mature after 15:00 London; no pre-entry window means no signal, while an in-position data defect fails only affected cells

risk.position_sizing: Each grid cell owns an isolated virtual portfolio. Within one cell, size same-timestamp symbol signals from that cell's common pre-entry equity snapshot so chart entry-to-stop risk equals 0.25% before costs; no equity, exposure, position or skip state crosses cells.
risk.gross_exposure_limit: Per cell: maximum six symbols and 1.50% aggregate initial stop risk; no global cap is shared across the 72 isolated cell portfolios
risk.leverage: Use the lower of stop-risk size and V2 limits; skip if valid size cannot be represented
risk.concurrent_positions: Within each cell, one per symbol and six across its universe; all 72 cells have independent positions, equity, exposure, overlap decisions and data-failure state

robustness_tests: Report all 72 R010 cells and retain the complete contemporaneous breadth-screening declaration ledger: R007 48 cells, R008 72 selectable cells plus two non-selectable diagnostics, R009 96 cells, R010 72 cells, and every identifiable legacy trial named by those records
Report every symbol and halves split at the exact UTC midpoint of V2's fixed development interval; a close exactly at midpoint belongs to the first half
Multiply spread, commission and slippage individually by two for cost stress

For each mode center N=5/displacement=0.5/hold=60/stop=1, rank dates by normal-cost pooled net R, tie by ascending date, remove its top five from the center and exact neighbors, and require retained normal- and doubled-cost net R to remain positive

For every center and neighbor, form a London-weekday daily net-R series from its first eligible post-warm-up date to development end, including zero on eligible no-trade dates; report a 95% percentile interval for mean daily net R from 10000 circular five-date block-bootstrap resamples with seed 2026010; the normal-cost center interval lower bound must exceed zero, while neighbor intervals are report-only
A mode advances only if its center and at least two exact one-axis neighbors N=3, N=7, displacement=1.0, hold=30, hold=120 and stop=2 pass all gates
costs: Use V2 timestamp-resolved or frozen fixed-fallback spread plus commission and slippage at every fill
Doubled stress multiplies each cost component by two
No swap because all positions close before 15:00 London
benchmarks: Opposite response mode on identical streak events
experiment.multiple_testing: The contemporaneous breadth-screening ledger contains all 288 selectable cells declared across R007-R010, plus R008's two frozen non-selectable diagnostics and all identifiable legacy trials named by those records, including R004/I-61, I-32/I-33/opening-breakout, I-12/I-40/wick/no-wick/outside-bar/key-reversal, and I-19/consecutive-close/streak/exhaustion/serial-dependence trials. Any cross-batch comparison or promotion must use this complete ledger even when family labels differ. If historical IDs or counts are incomplete, label multiplicity incomplete and prohibit a confirmatory claim. No best-cell or best-family rescue is allowed.
rejection_criteria: Reject a mode unless its center and at least two exact neighbors are positive after normal and doubled costs
Reject if the cluster is non-positive in either UTC-midpoint development half
Reject if fewer than three symbols have positive center net R in each half
Reject if the center has fewer than 300 pooled trades
Reject if five-date removal makes the center or required neighbors non-positive under either cost setting
Reject if the normal-cost center bootstrap interval does not lie wholly above zero
Reject affected cells on any invalid post-entry interval and prohibit promotion if a required cluster contains a failed cell
Never access the final holdout without explicit authorization for a separately frozen promoted version

pseudocode: Build valid London-aligned M15 bars causally from interval-start M1.
For N=3/5/7 require N strict same-sign close changes across contiguous bars and compute net displacement/ATR.
Map continuation or exhaustion mechanically and enter at signal close when that cell is flat.
Freeze the bid-chart ATR stop; from next M1 process adverse gap/intrabar stop before due exit.
Fail only affected cells on post-entry defects and publish all cells, neighbors and robustness rows.
required_libraries: existing V2 candle, timezone, cost, fill and R-accounting components
data_structures: Rolling strict close-sign window for N=3/5/7
edge_cases: duplicate M1 is invalid before aggregation
equal consecutive closes break the streak
elapsed gaps count in ATR but any event-window gap suppresses the signal
stop and time exit collide as stop first
gap stop uses worse executable open
implementation.computational_requirements: One causal pass per symbol; cache shared M15, ATR and streak features while preserving independent state for 72 cells.
known_backtester_gaps: Queue submission waits for V2's M15/fill/cell-state compatibility response and batch-specific confirmation of 72 isolated cells and required result rows
